queries.name: GetAuthor
queries.text:
SELECT author_id, name FROM authors
WHERE author_id = $1

queries.name: GetBook
queries.text:
SELECT book_id, author_id, isbn, book_type, title, year, available, tags FROM books
WHERE book_id = $1

queries.name: BooksByTitleYear
queries.text:
SELECT book_id, author_id, isbn, book_type, title, year, available, tags FROM books
WHERE title = $1 AND year = $2

queries.name: BooksByTags
queries.text:
SELECT 
  book_id,
  title,
  name,
  isbn,
  tags
FROM books
LEFT JOIN authors ON books.author_id = authors.author_id
WHERE tags && $1::varchar[]

queries.name: CreateAuthor
queries.text:
INSERT INTO authors (name) VALUES ($1)
RETURNING author_id, name

queries.name: CreateBook
queries.text:
INSERT INTO books (
    author_id,
    isbn,
    book_type,
    title,
    year,
    available,
    tags
) VALUES (
    $1,
    $2,
    $3,
    $4,
    $5,
    $6,
    $7
)
RETURNING book_id, author_id, isbn, book_type, title, year, available, tags

queries.name: UpdateBook
queries.text:
UPDATE books
SET title = $1, tags = $2
WHERE book_id = $3

queries.name: UpdateBookISBN
queries.text:
UPDATE books
SET title = $1, tags = $2, isbn = $4
WHERE book_id = $3
